NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author posted a before/after dark-mode screenshot in a comment, which answers the screenshot ask. There was no new push, and the description still has no issue link.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Before/after dark-mode screenshot provided (in a comment, not in the description) |
| ❌  | No "Fixes: #N" and no linked issue, so "help wanted" can't be checked; open issue #38931 looks like the match |
| ⚠️  | The Testing section only explains the change and doesn't say what was checked manually |
| ⚠️  | The added `right` placement rule is not shown in the screenshot |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" until the PR links the issue it fixes and that issue is confirmed "help wanted"; then hand it off for maintainer review.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshot! Could you add "Fixes: #N" to the description for the issue this addresses (maybe #38931?), and update the Testing section with what you checked manually, including the right-side arrow placement? See the [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html).
```
